nodes.text: Speak to Lorewalker Han in the upper Seat of Knowledge and choose “the Forgotten Depths beneath the Isle of Thunder.” Enter the legacy Raid Finder wing; no Tortos kill is needed for this toy.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Lorewalker Han at the Seat of Knowledge
destination.directions: Inside the upper Seat of Knowledge above Mogu’shan Palace. Use a supported current route to the upper building.

nodes.text: At the start of the Tortos section, find the ring of small water spouts around the larger return geyser. Use the small spouts for the stacking challenge; the central large geyser returns you upward.

recovery.text: This is in Forgotten Depths before Tortos. If you overshot into later sections, return through the dungeon paths; the large geysers provide upward travel. A Tortos kill is not the reward condition.

nodes.writtenDestination: Forgotten Depths legacy LFR: before entering Tortos’s arena, find the ring of small water spouts around the larger upward-return geyser. The small spouts are the challenge course.

nodes.text: Step onto a small geyser while facing the next. Turn in the air and land on another spout before Spray Water expires. Correct a slight miss by moving onto the spout while keeping your facing aimed at the following one. Build 250 consecutive stacks.

recovery.text: If the stack expires, begin a new chain. Avoid immunity effects that remove the debuff. Do not assert an achievement from this minigame; reaching the stacks and receiving the mailed toy are separate.

nodes.text: After reaching 250 stacks, visit a mailbox and collect Taoshi’s letter containing Shado-Pan Geyser Gun.

recovery.text: The item arrives by mail rather than appearing directly in bags. Check mail and bag space; Continue or the Tortos kill cannot manufacture the reward.

nodes.text: Use Shado-Pan Geyser Gun from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
